Job Description 
 
 
 Overview
 
 AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Web Application Developer to join our Technology Solutions team. In this role, you will help support and enhance a diverse portfolio of FDOT District 2 web applications, SharePoint solutions, Power Apps, Power Automate workflows, and Microsoft 365-based business systems.
 This is an exciting opportunity to work on innovative technology solutions that support transportation infrastructure initiatives while collaborating with developers, analysts, project managers, and client stakeholders. If you are passionate about software development, digital transformation, and engineering-driven technology solutions, we encourage you to apply.
 
 Your role
 Support and enhance existing web applications, SharePoint solutions, Power Apps, Power Automate workflows, and business systems.
 Troubleshoot and resolve application issues across web, database, server, and browser environments.
 Develop and maintain applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC, .NET, SQL Server, and Entity Framework.
 Implement new features and enhancements while improving usability, maintainability, and performance.
 Create and maintain SQL queries, data models, and application integrations.
 Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot SharePoint Online sites, lists, document libraries, permissions, and customized forms.
 Build and support Power Apps and Power Automate solutions, including workflows, notifications, connectors, and permissions management.
 Develop and maintain responsive user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and modern web design practices.
 Utilize Visual Studio and Git-based source control workflows to develop, test, and maintain software solutions.
 Assist with application deployments and troubleshooting in Microsoft IIS and Windows Server environments.
 Respond to production support requests, investigate root causes, coordinate corrective actions, and communicate progress to stakeholders.
 Collaborate with internal teams, FDOT staff, and technical administrators to deliver practical and effective technology solutions.
 Prepare and maintain technical documentation related to applications, workflows, configurations, deployments, and support processes.
 Follow established standards for software development, testing, security, accessibility, source control, and documentation.
 
 About you
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Web Development, Data Science, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical experience.
 Proficiency in developing, maintaining, or supporting web applications and business systems.
 Ability to work within existing codebases and implement well-documented enhancements and improvements.
 Proficiency in or familiarity with C#, ASP.NET MVC, .NET, SQL Server, Visual Studio, and Entity Framework.
 Proficiency in front-end technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and responsive web design.
 Ability to develop and understand SQL queries and relational database concepts.
 Aptitude for troubleshooting issues across application, database, server, and browser layers.
 Familiarity with Git source control workflows, including branching, committing, merging, and pull requests.
 Familiarity with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Lists, Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Forms, and Microsoft 365 integrations.
 Ability to support production applications and document issue resolution activities.
 Aptitude for collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders and communicating effectively across teams.
 Ability to work in client-controlled environments with varying security, access, and deployment requirements.
 Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving development environments.
 Preferred 5-10 years of professional experience in software development, application support, or related technical roles.
 
 Rewards & benefits
 At AtkinsRéalis, our values—Safety, Integrity, Collaboration, Innovation, and Excellence—are more than just words. They are the foundation of who we are and how we work. These principles shape our culture, guide our decisions, and inspire us to create an environment where every team member feels empowered to grow, succeed, and make a meaningful impact.
 
 Depending on your employment status, AtkinsRéalis benefits may include medical, dental, vision, company-paid life and short- and long-term disability benefits, employer-matched 401(k) with 100% vesting, employee stock purchase plan, Paid Time Off, leaves of absence options, flexible work options, recognition and employee satisfaction programs, employee assistance program, and voluntary benefits. You can review our comprehensive benefits page here. 
 
 About AtkinsRéalis
 We're AtkinsRéalis , a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
 
 Find out more .
 
 Additional information
 
 Expected compensation range is between $83,000-$130,000 annually depending on skills, experience, and geographical location. 
 
 Are you ready to expand your career with us? Apply today and help us shape something extraordinary. 
 
 AtkinsRéalis is an equal opportunity, Drug-Free employer EOE/Veteran/Disability. 
 
 Please review AtkinsRéalis’ Equal Opportunity Statement here. 
 
 Applications for this position are accepted on a rolling basis; no application deadline applies.
 
 AtkinsRéalis cares about your privacy and is committed to protecting your privacy. Please consult our Privacy Notice on our Careers site to know more about how we collect, use and transfer your Personal Data. By submitting your personal information to AtkinsRéalis, you confirm that you have read and accept our Privacy Notice.
 
 Note to staffing and direct hire agencies: 
 In the event a recruiter or agency who is not on our preferred supplier list submits a resume/candidate to anyone in the company, AtkinsRéalis family of companies, we explicitly reserve the right to recruit and hire the candidate(s) at our discretion and without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. https://careers.atkinsrealis.com/recruitment-agencies
